forecastReasoning.narrative:
Trough / Shortwave Ejection governs the 12Z Day 1–12Z Day 2 period. The 12Z Day 1 issuance carries a MDT maximum, with Slight-or-greater probabilities covering 31% of the domain. The primary corridor peaks near 12Z Day 1, when mean initiation reaches 2% and expected storm coverage reaches 11%.

An ejecting upper wave and deepening surface response increase ascent and organize the frontal zones. A representative corridor sounding contains about 3011 J/kg CAPE, 632 m²/s² SRH, 85 kt deep-layer shear, 848 m LCLs, STP 7.0, and VTP 2.8. Flow increases from roughly 45 kt at 850 mb to 69 kt at 500 mb and 105 kt at 250 mb.

Maximum probabilities are 15% tornado, 30% hail, and 5% wind; large hail is the leading hazard signal. The analog ensemble has high agreement (93% confidence; 30 members), with mean moisture return 96%, clearing 83%, forcing 83%, and cap persistence 41%. No ensemble failure mode exceeds the reporting threshold.

Coherent synoptic pattern and frontal geometry (99%)
Strong low-level hodograph curvature (632 m²/s² SRH)
limitingFactors: Low or highly localized initiation signal (2% corridor mean)
Sparse expected storm coverage (11% corridor mean)
